statement: This sketch creates a dynamic, evolving field of interconnected geometric forms that continuously morph and transform. The system begins with a web of abstract shapes that flow and resonate with each other through time-based distortion patterns. As the animation progresses, certain connections between shapes break apart, sending individual components along precise helical trajectories that spiral away from their original positions. These separated elements follow mathematically defined paths, leaving luminous trails behind them as they move through three-dimensional space. The entire composition shifts through a constantly changing color palette, with each shape maintaining its own hue while participating in the collective chromatic dance. The result is a mesmerizing visualization of interconnected systems that both dissolve and reconstitute themselves in an endless cycle of separation and reunion.
